'''Big Blismo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[General/Legends|general]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
During his time as general, a group of his men kidnapped an individual, which resulted in a man named [[Lergo Brazee]] hiring a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] to rescue the individual. Afterwards, Lergo Brazee hired the mercenary to assassinate Big Blismo. The attempt was successful.
